name: @digitaplatform/veloluck-workbench
description: Veloluck Workbench: a FREE signature of Veloluck GmbH, the fictional bike workshop and shop that opens digita show; the look of the bench: copper #B8541E, warm neutrals, a dot motif and a sharp diagonal, Space Grotesk headlines over Inter. One of three looks the company chooses from in the signature menu. Made from signature.json by make-signature, which refuses a text or control pair below WCAG AA except step 600 drawn as text, which no brand colour passes in both modes until digita-platform#240; ships as pure config (no runtime CSS).
